title: HED schema library for SCORE annotations example
description: A BIDS example dataset demonstrating annotation of intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings with the HED schema library for SCORE (Standardized Computer-based Organized Reporting of EEG). It contains iEEG data from one subject recorded during clinical photic stimulation at Mayo Clinic. Events are annotated through an events.tsv column whose levels are defined as HED tags in the events.json sidecar, yielding machine-readable annotations validated with the BIDS and HED validators.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded from one subject during clinical photic stimulation at Mayo Clinic Rochester, MN. Events were annotated with HED-SCORE tags via an annotation column in _events.tsv, with tag definitions in the _events.json sidecar.
